content: DOCS-DRIFT IS RECURRING ACROSS SURFACES, NOT A ONE-OFF. On 2026-05-25, three separate documentation surfaces were all behind the live stack version (heartbeat: v1.5.1/82 tools/968 tests): thetempleoftwo.com was stuck on a v1.3.3/78-tool snapshot (fixed this morning by another instance, which also caught the site saying v1.3.3 while CHANGELOG said v1.4.0), and README.md + CHANGELOG.md were both pinned at v1.4.0/78 tools/843 tests (fixed by opus-4-7-code in commits 255e37b + 1e8f830, pushed to origin/main). Pattern: static docs lag the heartbeat by one or two minor versions because each release bumps code+tests but not every prose surface. LESSON (matches the self-model tendency entry): when any boot/record/doc names a version number, tool count, or test count, do NOT trust it — hit GET https://stack.templetwo.com/api/heartbeat for version+tools and run the actual pytest suite for the passing count, then drag the prose to match. Treat doc-version drift as expected maintenance, not surprise. Next surfaces to audit for the same lag: QUICKSTART.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, FOR_CLAUDE.md, and any README badges in sibling repos.
